subject: StratusAI renewal orientation, capacity uplift & QBR time poll
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@stratus.ai>, Emily Park <emily.park@stratus.ai>, procurement@stratus.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal orientation: StratusAI term review & QBR scheduling

Hi Tom / Emily / procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive check-in this week. Per our conversation, I wanted to start a renewal orientation thread to align timelines, stakeholders, and next steps so we keep the March 2026 renewal window smooth. High level summary and asks below.

What we propose
- Target renewal window: week of 2026-03-01 (flexible if you need earlier slot)
- Capacity uplift: you mentioned a planned +40% token volume growth starting Sept 2025 — we should scope reserved capacity vs burst options
- Term options: 12 / 24 / 36-month (we'll share price delta and commitment tiers)

Immediate next steps (action owners)
1) We shared an initial SOW + Mutual Action Plan attached (Stratus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx) — please review and mark any redlines. (Tom / Emily)
2) Procurement: please confirm the person(s) who will own contract redlines and PO timing (procurement@stratus.ai)
3) Internal: Ben will prepare uplift pricing buckets and Laura will coordinate the QBR agenda. Sergio, can you pull the perf baseline for current lineage?

QBR scheduling: propose a 60-minute kickoff QBR to align stakeholders and go over the MAP + SOW. Suggested slots next week (PT):
- Tue 05/27 10:00–11:00
- Wed 05/28 11:00–12:00
- Thu 05/29 09:00–10:00

Please confirm who needs to attend from your side and which slot works best. If you prefer a calendar poll, happy to send one.

Attachments: Stratus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (annotated), Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action checklist).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this runbook underway.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first LLM inference
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@stratus.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@stratus.ai>, procurement@stratus.ai, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 17:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal orientation: StratusAI term review & QBR scheduling

Thanks Jasmine — this looks great and captures our priorities. A couple quick notes: 
- Confirm procurement: I am looping in our procurement alias (procurement@stratus.ai) and legal (legal@stratus.ai) — legal will likely push a few standard redlines.
- Attendees: from Stratus we expect myself, Emily (program lead), and Dave Kim (platform ops) for the initial QBR. Can you add space for our engineering lead if we need to dive into perf?
- Capacity uplift: yes, +40% is the plan but we may phase it (Q3 ramp into Q4 steady state). We need cost examples for both reserved capacity and pay-as-you-go.

For the proposed slots Wed 05/28 11:00 PT works best for me. If you can send a calendar invite I will route to legal / procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom Nguyen
Head of Data Platform, StratusAI
Tom.Nguyen@stratus.ai
+1 206-555-0123
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@stratus.ai>, Emily Park <emily.park@stratus.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal orientation: StratusAI term review & QBR scheduling

Thanks — quick internal alignment from my side: 
- Ben: please prepare 3 uplift pricing scenarios (conservative + phased ramp, moderate commit, and aggressive reserved capacity discount) and include token/unit math so Stratus can compare.
- Ops: I will pull the last 6 months of throughput/latency KPIs and a short perf baseline doc for the QBR (will attach capacity_uplift_pricing.csv + perf_baseline_summary.pdf to the working folder).
- Risks: note that if they take reserved capacity we should include a fallback model variant for cost-sensitive paths (we should show the latency/cost tradeoffs).

Jasmine — I'll be on the QBR and can handle the technical section. Laura — can you draft the QBR agenda (30 min business + 30 min technical + 15 min next-steps buffer)? We'll keep it tight.

Sergio 
VP Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

> Hi Tom / Emily / procurement team —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive check-in this week. Per our conversation, I wanted to start a renewal orientation thread to align timelines, stakeholders, and next steps so we keep the March 2026 renewal window smooth. High level summary and asks below.

Thanks for confirming availability Tom — Wed 05/28 11:00 PT is tentatively reserved. I've created a short agenda and updated the MAP with two timeline columns ("Customer review" and "Redwood deliverables"). See link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC3StratusRenewal

I've also uploaded a lightweight pricing CSV (capacity_uplift_pricing.csv) with conservative/moderate/aggressive rows so you can preview order-of-magnitude impact before the QBR.

Action items for this thread:
- Tom / Emily: please add any SOW redlines directly to the PDF and drop comments in the MAP by EOD Tue 05/27.
- Procurement: confirm contract owner & PO timeline.
- Ben: prepare pricing scenarios and finalize before Wed QBR.

I'll send the calendar invite for Wed 05/28 11:00 PT and include a short dial-in + recording consent. If legal prefers a separate session for redlines, flag and we'll schedule a dedicated contract review.

Thanks — see you Wed.

Best,
Jasmine

Attachments referenced: Stratus_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (updated), Stratus_MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline columns), capacity_uplift_pricing.csv (preview)

Subject: Re: Renewal orientation: StratusAI term review & QBR scheduling

Thanks all — Wed 05/28 11:00 PT confirmed on our side. Attendees: myself, Emily Park, Dave Kim (platform ops). Legal will try to join but if they can't make it we'll route redlines asynchronously.

Two quick asks for the QBR:
1) Please include a short slide showing historical token consumption (monthly) and a 3-month projection for our proposed uplift.
2) Have a draft of the 24-month pricing delta ready — that's our preferred term to evaluate if the economics make sense.

Appreciate the coordination. See you on Wed.

Tom
notes: Thread created to coordinate renewal kickoff, QBR scheduling, capacity uplift scoping and initial SOW review. Internal attendees will prepare pricing options and perf baselines; external confirmed Wed 2025-05-28 11:00 PT for QBR.
